elements.label: Version settings form (Options / New Version Options) scrolling inside the panel

elements.manual_reason: No candidate box covers the mouse cursor; it travels down the checkbox column to the 'Add as report parameter choice to all reports' checkbox.
elements.label: Mouse cursor

pattern.description: A long settings form scrolls upward inside a fixed panel mask while the cursor tracks down the checkbox column toward the next option to toggle.
pattern.why_premium: The scroll is smooth and short rather than a jump, keeping the viewer oriented in a dense form; the cursor movement leads the eye to the option the narration is about.

build_hint.gsap: Wrap the form in an overflow:hidden panel; gsap.to(form, {y: '-=220', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}) while gsap.to(scrollThumb, {y: '+=140', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}); in parallel tween the cursor down to the target checkbox with ease 'power1.inOut'.
build_hint.remotion: translateY of the form = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [0, -220]); drive the scrollbar thumb from the same progress; cursor y via interpolate with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad).

notes: Camera move is none; pan_y reflects the in-panel scroll. The 'Add as report parameter' checkbox appears to become ticked under the cursor in the end frame, but it is obscured by the cursor so it is not listed as a separate element.
